text:
alex: quick morning async — did a pager sweep from 02:00-04:00, updated the runbook for ephemeral cache thrash, and bumped eviction policy on shard-3. no open incidents.

maria: nice, saw the runbook diff. left a tiny comment on the fallback step. also adjusted a noisy alert: lowered alert cardinality and added a 2m for(1m) window.

chris: on the latency front i dug into the 95th — confirmed many short-lived connections causing KV cache churn. changed `kv.eviction.target = 0.7` on shard-3 and restarted the worker pool. cpu spiked briefly then recovered.

alex: thanks chris. what's the restart command we used? saving for runbook.

chris: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-worker-shard-3`

maria: added the snippet to the runbook under "mitigation steps". also added a note to run `curl -s http://metrics/service?series=kv.cache.hit_ratio` to verify hit ratio after changes.

 taylor: quick FYI — i've got the oncall handoff at 09:30 UTC. alex can you DM me any context i should know?

alex: pinged you with a short summary. main things: watch for cache thrash regressions, alert with runbook link, and any pagers tied to `inference.gateway.timeout` should escalate to eng-platform.

mohit: about the alert tune — i recommend we add a transient-suppression for canary deployments so we don't get spikes during rollouts. i can open a tiny PR to alertmanager config.

maria: +1 to suppression for `k8s_deployment_revision` label. reduces false positives when a deploy changes pod counts.

chris: i pushed a hotfix CR for the eviction threshold to repo: `gitlab.com/redwood/infra/kv-config` branch `hotfix/eviction-shard3`. please review — it's tiny.

alex: ack, i'll review in a few. blocker for me rn is the security review on the private deployment test; if that drags, the dedicated capacity perf test will be delayed.

 taylor: noted. if review blocks the test, we can run a limited perf sweep on staging instead.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `kv-worker-shard-3` — build 2026.3.14-783 :deploy: 

chris: deploy completed, pods stable. metrics show hit_ratio up from 0.62 -> 0.89 after change. logging the delta in the runbook entry.

alex: awesome, thanks everyone. end-of-check: nothing urgent to escalate. i'll do the CR review and the security review follow-up this afternoon. :thumbsup:
